items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That must be Phil Feathering. ... [INTERVIEWEE] I don't believe.

ctx.x: Session, yeah. That was downtown Chicago. Yeah, but that's the guy I said went away, and I never could get no royalties or nothing from him.
That must be Phil Feathering. Yeah, yeah. And those are the same ones with Richard M. Jones? Or was that...
